scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.read
scopes.description: Read BW modelling objects and query data

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.analyst
scopes.description: Reporting only: run queries and read the data behind them (a subset of read)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.write
scopes.description: Create, change, delete and activate BW objects (implies read and analyst)

role-templates.name: BWReader
role-templates.description: Read-only access to BW modeling objects via MCP

role-templates.name: BWAnalyst
role-templates.description: Run BW queries and read the data behind them via MCP

role-templates.name: BWDeveloper
role-templates.description: Full read and write access to BW modeling objects via MCP

role-collections.name: BW MCP Reader
role-collections.description: Read BW modelling objects and query data via MCP. Write tools are not offered.

role-collections.name: BW MCP Analyst
role-collections.description: Ask questions of BW data: run queries, read the values behind them. A small client — the modelling tools are not offered.

role-collections.name: BW MCP Developer
role-collections.description: Read and change BW modeling objects via MCP
